what_this_is: Subsystem ATTRIBUTION (not names) for the retained net functions, derived from the shipped image.  Evidence class per function: A0 name-implied (accepted as given), A1 witnessed nRF5340 NET peripheral register block, A2 descriptive global-name prefix, A2b global ownership learned from A0/A1/A2 co-occurrence, A3 every attributed direct neighbour agrees.  A3 is the weakest and is separable.  NOTHING here is applied to any source tree; see net_test_coverage.md section 10 for the measurement that justifies it and for the correction it makes to section 5.6.
address_space: analysis base 0x01008000 (Ghidra import), NOT the 0x01008800 runtime/link base
